reason: Planning cannot proceed because the required design parameters are missing and cannot be invented. Previous feedback identified two unresolved issues: (1) the direction of added delay (e.g., uplink, downlink, or bidirectional) is not specified, and (2) no replication unit or sample-size rationale is supplied. Additionally, "configuration A" is a name only — no concrete parameter values (delay magnitude, bandwidth cap, queue discipline, loss rate, topology, etc.) are provided. Without these, no valid protocol can be constructed for either registered runner (emulated-netem-v1 or real-world-iperf-v1). No registered check exists that covers this claim. Proposing a protocol with invented or guessed values is prohibited.
